message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "longitudinal_imaging_trend_synthesis", "description": "When interpreting a series of chest X-rays from different timepoints, do not rely on single-image reports or assume chronology from tool outputs alone.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the comparison of multiple medical images (e.g., chest X-rays, CTs) taken at different times to assess disease progression, resolution, or stability.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If presented with longitudinal imaging data: (1) invoke `chest_xray_classifier` individually on each timepoint to extract static findings (e.g., opacity scores, effusion presence); (2) manually align these findings by their explicit timestamps; (3) synthesize the trend (progression/resolution/stability) based on the comparative analysis of these extracted metrics. Do NOT attempt to infer trends from a single aggregated report or assume the tool output order matches clinical chronology."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
